identity_rule: claim only the exact current offerId; triggerId remains decision context and may recur
commit_order: Atomically commit ACCEPT for the current offerId before sending; then send; then close this screen if still current.
send_failure: A send failure is primary and closing this screen is still attempted.
transition_failure: A close failure leaves this offerId terminal; later paths for the same instance remain NOOP.
exception_rule: If send and close both fail, retain send as primary and suppress close in execution order.
observable_effect: Emit at most one CHOSEN decision for this offer instance; terminal state is discarded once no current or pending lifecycle can race with it.

identity_rule: claim only the exact current offerId; a later offer may reuse triggerId
commit_order: Atomically commit DECLINE for the current offerId before sending; then send; then close this screen if still current.
send_failure: A send failure is primary and closing this screen is still attempted.
transition_failure: A close failure leaves this offerId terminal; later paths for the same instance remain NOOP.
exception_rule: If send and close both fail, retain send as primary and suppress close in execution order.
observable_effect: Emit at most one DECLINED decision for this offer instance without poisoning a later offer that reuses triggerId.

identity_rule: pre-open bootstrap and open screen compete for one exact offerId claim
commit_order: Atomically commit TIMEOUT for offerId before sending; pre-open expiry creates no screen, while an open screen then closes if still current.
send_failure: A send failure is primary; the applicable close or transition is still attempted.
transition_failure: A close or removal failure leaves this offerId terminal and cannot authorize another send.
exception_rule: If send and transition both fail, retain send as primary and suppress transition in execution order.
observable_effect: Emit one TIMED_OUT decision for the offer instance; stale timeout of offer A cannot clear current or pending offer B.

identity_rule: claim the exact offerId owned by the closing screen
commit_order: Atomically commit ESC for offerId before sending; then send; then close this screen if still current.
send_failure: A send failure is primary and closing this screen is still attempted.
transition_failure: Close or removal failure leaves this offerId terminal; onRemoved remains NOOP for settlement.
exception_rule: Retain the first failure and suppress later close/removal failures in execution order.
observable_effect: Emit at most one DECLINED decision for this offer instance.

identity_rule: compare outgoing and incoming offerId; settle an outgoing current or pending offer even when no InsightOfferScreen is current
commit_order: Publish the incoming offer into a bounded pending slot; commit and send the outgoing offerId before attempting the screen switch; promote pending to current only after installation succeeds.
send_failure: An outgoing send failure is primary and installation is still attempted; its offerId remains terminal.
transition_failure: Installation failure keeps the incoming offer non-authoritative in the pending slot for retry; it cannot strand an authoritative snapshot without a screen.
exception_rule: If send and installation both fail, retain send as primary and suppress installation in execution order.
observable_effect: Outgoing emits at most one DECLINED decision; incoming is either installed as current or remains bounded pending and reachable for retry.

identity_rule: claim the exact offerId owned by activeTransition.handle().newScreen()
commit_order: Atomically commit ANIMATED_OPEN_CANCELLED for offerId before sending the decline; then clear only matching current/pending ownership.
send_failure: A send failure remains observable after the offerId is committed terminal.
transition_failure: Cancellation cannot leave the offer current or pending without a visible or retryable screen.
exception_rule: A later removal callback is NOOP for settlement and any later lifecycle failure is suppressed after the send failure.
observable_effect: Cancelling the 250 ms animated open emits at most one decline and leaves no invisible unsettled offer.

identity_rule: claim the screen's exact offerId only when no earlier cause won
commit_order: Atomically commit REMOVED_EXCEPTIONALLY for offerId before sending; then continue all base removal stages.
send_failure: A send failure is primary and later removal stages are still attempted.
transition_failure: A later removal-stage failure cannot replace the committed cause.
exception_rule: BongScreenBase retains the first failure and suppresses later lifecycle failures in execution order.
observable_effect: Exceptional removal emits at most one decline and cannot clear a different current or pending offer.

identity_rule: an already committed offerId is immutable only while its current/pending lifecycle can still race
commit_order: Observe the bounded in-flight terminal claim and return before send or transition.
transition_failure: No screen transition is attempted and no different offerId is mutated.
observable_effect: No duplicate decision or transition occurs; historical offer IDs are not retained after their lifecycle becomes unreachable.
